what: TTE and rhythm monitoring now recommended and out of the stop rule; NCCT, CTA and CTP (EVT decision) remain. Class STOP-SCOPE (ruling 3, all 30 ISCH-STR cases): the benchmark has one final assessment, so the stop rule holds the acute decision work-up (NCCT, CTA, perfusion or MRI where the decision needs it, admission bloods, ECG). Drug-interaction checks, TTE, Holter/telemetry and extra panels went from required to recommended and out of required_before_assessment (22 cases), except where the accepted diagnosis names the etiology the test establishes: those stay required but leave the stop rule (M01, M02, M03 rhythm monitoring for the paroxysmal AF; P03 cultures, TTE and TEE; P05 venous duplex and bubble echo; RP03 bubble echo; RP04 antiphospholipid panel; RP05 NOTCH3).

CT perfusion and the perfusion-MRI follow-up rewritten: hypoperfused tissue (Tmax >6 s) 118 mL, ischaemic core 18 mL, mismatch/penumbra 100 mL, ratio 6.6, in findings, impression and quantitative fields (penumbra_volume_mL 100); the MRI follow-up now describes an MR perfusion (DSC) study with a DWI/ADC core instead of CT perfusion text.

Class SWALLOW (ruling 6): a must 'Screen swallowing at the bedside with a validated tool before any oral food, fluids or oral medication, and keep nil by mouth until the screen is passed (AHA/ASA 2026)' added to 24 ISCH-STR cases that lacked one, with aspiration precautions where the case has dysarthria (and in P04 for the severe MCA syndrome). Not added to M04, RP01, RP03, RS03 (already present) or RM02, RM03 (no neurological deficit). P04's must adds aspiration precautions for the severe right MCA syndrome.
